title: Uruguayan Beef Empanadas
description: A classic Uruguayan dish featuring crispy beef empanadas, perfect as a snack or light meal.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine ground beef, salt, black pepper, and Uruguayan spices. Mix well.
Divide empanada dough into 4-6 pieces, depending on size.
Roll out each piece into a thin circle, about 1/8 inch thick.
Place a tablespoon of beef mixture in the center of each circle.
Brush the edges with egg and fold the dough in half to form a triangle.
Press the edges together to seal the empanada.
Repeat with the remaining dough and beef mixture.
Place the empanadas on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Brush the tops with egg and sprinkle with salt.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown.
Let cool for a few minutes before serving.
